confidentUnsupported.evidence: the issue likely lies with the selector or control unit. This requires an appliance engineer to inspect

rationale: The assistant never identified E011 as a key-held-pressed code and ignored the customer's key detail that the panel was wiped with a damp cloth and spray just before the fault. It asked generic power-cut and key-lock questions, then escalated to an engineer, blaming the selector or control unit without evidence. It never suggested drying the panel and isolating power at the cooker switch, which would have fixed it. No part was recommended, so it avoided the unnecessary-part failure, but the escalation was premature and the homeowner was poorly served.
